notes.title: Hotfix Now Live! (Tracker Update)
notes.notes: [p]Hello Dragon hunters![/p][p align="start"]We hope you've been having fun hunting down the new Champions and theorycrafting on the Tracker![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Today we're pushing out a small patch that adress the bugs mentioned in the previous Patch Notes and help out with some of the crashes and other performance issues that we've been hearing about from players. We're also taking the chance to slip in a few little extra fixes while we're at it.[/p][p][/p][p]If you experience any bugs while playing, please be sure to let us know  through our Discord. Let us know your thoughts on the Tracker Update![/p][p][/p][p]🐛[b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]Quests[/i][/p][list][*][p]Players can now successfully complete Endgame Hunt 7-2[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck during the Endgame Quest 7-4 because "The Monster of [i]Erde-nòr[/i]" would not spawn properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player wouldn't be able to progress in the quest “Blood Sorcery” when using[i] any execution[/i] skill to defeat the shamans.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][i]Talents[/i] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed the Tracker talent "Mounted Hunt" leaving the Tracker half-mounted when using two movement skills consecutively[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Tracker talent "Pack Hunter" appearing in the Grand Benedictor for all classes and the Gift of the Eternal menus; equipping it through Grand Benedictor no longer causes crashes during combat[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could see a Knight's talent that wasn’t supposed to be available[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Modifiers & Skills[/i][/p][list][*][p]Class-specific modifiers now correctly apply only to compatible skills, preventing crashes when equipped on the wrong character[/p][/*][*][p]Limitless modifier now correctly affects Pale Dragon's Aura, Cobalt Dragon's Aura, and Toxic Spray[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing cooldown tag on Oracle Pythoderkon’s Premonition skill[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Performances[/i][/p][list][*][p]Resolved GPU performance issues in the City of Montescail, improving overall stability[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p] [i]Miscellaneous[/i][/p][list][*][p]Resolved occasional collision issues with projectile skills in certain areas[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Loot Filter to remove the incorrect “non-draconic” mention in the fragment tab[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Loot Filter failed to load saved presets properly[/p][/*][*][p]Loot Filter default state now correctly displays draconic items[/p][/*][*][p]Improved controller navigation in the Grand Benedictor menu; all options are now fully accessible[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed scrolling issues with the mouse wheel in various menus[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could make some popup button unavailable[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the placeholders appearing in the Gift of the Eternal when converting ingredients to gold[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed augment passive "Faith" visual effect that would loop infinitely[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Tracker Update & Patch Notes are here!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Dragon hunters! Patch is Now Live![/p][p]We are delighted to announce that [b]Dragonkin's Second Major Update, the Tracker patch has arrived![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/368c7a726a1987f93d7d6e0d500991958669b7ed.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b]Please take a look at our Trailer:[/b][/p][previewyoutube="HfxaottJLJY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]  [b]Download your Founder Pack 3:[/b]



This patch introduces our 2nd Major Update features and QoL updates requested by the community, along with several bug fixes.

As always, thank you to everyone who reported bugs and provided feedback to us!

Your support is crucial in shaping the future of Dragonkin and thanks to our fans, we’ve been able to go beyond the scope of what was in our initial roadmap.

Patch notes will feature a [b]\[🔥][/b] emoji whenever the change is based on community feedback!

[/p][h3][b]\[Highlights][/b][/h3][p]

    [b]New Class:  Qara Tani, the Tracker[/b] [/p][quote][p][i]Named Qara Tani, she is a tracker from the Qhongirat, using the advanced archery techniques of her clan along with a deadly poison derived from the blood of a Green Dragon.

As a Dragon hunter, she is able to wield all the martial techniques of her clan.
Her specialty: striking without being struck.

Coming with a total of 17 skills, she has both melee and ranged abilities.[/i][/p][/quote][p]     
    [b]New Skills for each class[/b][/p][quote][p][i]2 new skills for each class, including the Knight, the Barbarian, and the Oracle.

17 skills for the Tracker.[/i][/p][/quote][p] 
    [b]New Biome: [i]Erde-nòr[/i][/b][/p][quote][p][i]2 new regions: The Volcanic Plains of Koleos & The Resurgence Stronghold.

New dungeon purification.

New enemies, and bosses to discover.[/i][/p][/quote][p] 
    [b]New Modifiers[/b][/p][quote][p][i]9 new modifiers, including specific class modifiers and common modifiers.[/i][/p][/quote][p] 
    [b]New Endgame content & Draconic Tarot[/b][/p][quote][p][i]New endgame hunts, dungeons, enemies, bosses and rewards.

With the Draconic Tarot, you will be able to customize your Chaos Hunts modifiers.[/i][/p][/quote][p] 
    [b]New Enemies : Champions[/b][/p][quote][p][i]The Champions are new enemies you’ll be able to find in quests.

These champions are now encountered at the end of an endgame hunt, replacing our old elite dragons. For now, only the newest hunts feature champions, with almost each new hunt having an exclusive enemy.[/i][/p][/quote][p] 
    [b]New City feature: The Draconic Atlas[/b][/p][quote][p][i]The Draconic Atlas is designed to help you learn more about the enemies you encountered during your hunts, while also providing passive bonuses that apply to all characters tied to the same City.[/i][/p][/quote][p] 
    [b]New Quality of Life (QoL) features: Loot Filter, Death Recap, and more…[/b][/p][quote][p][i]With the loot filter, you’ll be able to create templates, set rules, and sort them by priority. But also, hide, display, or highlight specific types of items.  The Death Recap will help you to interpret what caused you to die.[/i][/p][/quote][p] 
    [b]Founder Pack 3 available[/b][/p][quote][p][i]Dragonkin: The Banished. Founder Pack 3 contains:

6 exclusive pieces of equipment including a chest and a helmet for the Knight, Oracle and Barbarian.

6 exclusive pieces of equipment including 3 chests and 3 helmets for the Tracker.

2 exclusive death visual effects for your character.

The exclusive pack “Springtime Alliance” includes cosmetic elements for your city: statues, roofs, flags and pennants.
[/i][/p][/quote][p] 
[/p][h3][b]\[New Features][/b][/h3][p]
🎮[b]Gameplay[/b]

    New content for each class, including new skills and modifiers

     [i]Knight[/i]       [/p][p][/p][p]Shielded attack[/p][quote][p][i]Lothair strikes with his shield, dealing physical damage based on his Block stat. Like every basic skill, an enemy hit by the ability generates Energy.

Also, worth pointing out: Defensive Blow counts as both a melee hit and a projectile.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][p]Heaven’s Hope[/p][quote][p][i]Lothair invokes a burning light. healing nearby allies over time and dealing fire damage to enemies in the area each second.

He can move freely while it’s active and cast other abilities, such as Brave Charge and Intense Propulsion, without interrupting Heaven’s Hope, and vice versa.[/i][/p][/quote][p] 
      [i]Oracle[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Energy Projection [/p][quote][p][i]Fires a psychic projectile that pierces enemies, dealing physical damage, and generating Energy on-hit. Every third shot deals bonus damage.

[b]Vision:[/b] Directly launch the third projectile.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][p]Pythoderkon’s Premonition[/p][quote][p][i]Electrane zaps nearby enemies, dealing electric damage over time and becomes Unstoppable, gaining massive resistance but becoming immobilized for a short duration.

[b]Vision:[/b] Heals herself every second for the duration.[/i][/p][/quote][p]
      [i]Barbarian[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Spear of Ice[/p][quote][p][i]Rurik launches a spear in the target direction, dealing ice damage and piercing enemies. Each enemy hit generates Energy.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][p]Unleashed Frenzy[/p][quote][p][i]Rurik slams his arm down, dealing physical damage to all enemies struck within the area, scaling with Attack and Thorn. On cast, Rurik gains a temporary boost to Armor and Thorns for a short time.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][p]      [i]Tracker[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]New armors & weapons[/p][/*][*][p]17 exclusive active skills (including the 5 you already knew from the prologue sequence)[/p][/*][*][p]8 New passive skills[/p][/*][*][p]4 New Talents   [/p][/*][*][p]2 Exclusive modifiers[/p][/*][/list][p]    [/p][p]       [i]Modifiers[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Power Supply[/p][quote][p][i](Knight only) The modified skill generates fuel for each energy point spent.[/i][/p][/quote][p]   [/p][p]Enhanced Vision[/p][quote][p][i](Oracle only) Damage from the modified skill has a chance to generate Vision points on-hit.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][p]Foresight[/p][quote][p][i](Oracle only) Automatically cast the modified skill in its Vision ‘mode’ if possible, with a reduced Vision cost of 40 (instead of 50).[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][p]Full of Rage[/p][quote][p][i](Barbarian only) Damage from the modified skill has a chance to generate Rage on-hit.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][p]Appeasement[/p][quote][p][i](Barbarian only) While the Rage is active, using the modified skill reduces its cooldown by half, but ends the Rage immediately.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][p]Limitless[/p][quote][p][i](Channel skills only) The modified skill continuously triggers its wyrmling ‘on-cast’ effects while active.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][p]Focus[/p][quote][p][i]The modified skill is slower but deals increased damage.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][p]      [i]Onboarding[/i][/p][p][/p][p]       🔥Added new quest rewards system with multiple choices[/p][quote][p][i]As part of our work on the onboarding, skill rewards are now offered in the first chapter of the story . These rewards are meant to smooth out the early game progression, while also giving you some meaningful choices that random loot just can’t guarantee.

We want early players to discover more skills and mechanics sooner, and open up theorycrafting in the early stages of the game.[/i][/p][/quote][p]  [/p][list][*][p]🔥Shortened the prologue sequence and reworked the tutorial section    [/p][/*][*][p]🔥Removed Montescail’s initial walk / visit and added tutorials for fast travel in the city    [/p][/*][*][p]🔥The minimap and overlay map are now displayed in the prologue [/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]We decided to shorten the prologue sequence (without altering the cinematics) by a few minutes, making it about half as long as before. We’ve also doubled down on the initial “skip” popup, since some players were understandably confused about this part of the story.

The tutorial should feel smoother now, with your squad only helping you during the invasion. We also added extra pop-ups to help newer players get into the Ancestral Grid. We know the grid will eventually need more handholding, but we didn’t want to completely stop the action this early on.
Montescail’s ascension can now be skipped entirely via teleport, with proper tutorials and no required dialogue.

With these changes, plus quest rewards that now offer proper fragment progression, we’re aiming to improve the early game rhythm of fighting, storytelling, and theorycrafting.

If you’re new to Hack & Slash, don’t worry, you’ll still be able to roll through early enemies, and think about the details later.[/i][/p][/quote][p]  
✨[b]Quality of Life (QoL)[/b]

[/p][list][*][p] Added a Controls option at first launch    [/p][/*][*][p] Added a tutorial when entering endgame for the first time    [/p][/*][*][p] Added options to limit ragdoll physics (for players who felt it was too much)[/p][/*][*][p]Delayed surrounding enemies spawners when coming back to a level after using the backwarp portal (except if they are quest related)[/p][/*][/list][p]
🖥️[b]Menu & UI[/b]  [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]🔥Added a Loot Filter + Rename Feature[/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]As one of the most hotly requested features since the start of Early Access, we added a Loot Filter and also a way to rename your templates / layouts for Chests, Loot Filter, and the Arsenal.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][list][*][p]🔥Deleted the notion of 'Gear score / Item level' on items[/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]We felt like this feature was more confusing than anything, and are now putting more emphasis on the primary affix of weapons and armors, since it’s the most interesting part of the gear for newer players.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a Death recap[/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]Death happens fast, and you don't always know what happened.

The Death recap will help you to interpret what caused you to die. Specifically, when there are a lot of enemies or chaotic fights.[/i][/p][/quote][p]  [/p][list][*][p] Updated tooltips for various character and wyrmling skills to include missing information such as duration and energy costs    [/p][/*][*][p] Added info values to potion effect tooltips    [/p][/*][*][p] Added options to set health bar visibility for allies and enemies    [/p][/*][*][p] Added tooltips to icons in the Battle Log when hovered    [/p][/*][*][p] Integrated player menu textures for additional character classes    [/p][/*][*][p] Added new ring and pendant icons for more variety[/p][/*][/list][p]
🔊[b]Music & SFX[/b] [/p][p][/p][list][*][p] Added physical materials to improve footstep sounds on different surfaces (such as wood, ice, mud, sand, bone...)[/p][/*][*][p]Added more UI sounds (notably in the city and on crafting interfaces)    [/p][/*][*][p] Added more sounds for existing characters, enemies, and skills[/p][/*][*][p]Audio filter option added in the settings (you can now dIsable underwater sound effects)[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]\[Update][/b][/h3][p]
🎮[b]Gameplay[/b]

     [i]Barbarian[/i] [/p][p]
Rage (innate ability) has been reworked:

Any damage dealt or taken enables Rage generation, decreasing when out of combat for a short time. Once the gauge is full, the Barbarian enters Rage for a fixed duration, dealing increased damage with decreased energy costs. [/p][list][*][p] Rage damage bonus: 0 to 10% (depending on Rage) → 20%    [/p][/*][*][p] Rage cost reduction: 0% to 25% (depending on Rage) → 30%    [/p][/*][*][p] Max Rage: 10 → 100    [/p][/*][*][p] Rage gain: 0.5 per hit (or hit received) → 10 per second    [/p][/*][*][p] Rage loss: 1 per second (after 0.5s) → 5 per second (after 1s)    [/p][/*][*][p] Rage duration: 8s    [/p][/*][*][p] NEW: Indirect damage (thorn, DoT) now triggers Rage generation [/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]Rurik will need to use a bit more brainpower with this update.

We felt like the Barbarian’s innate passive was a bit too simple, it either took forever to build early game, or filled up instantly in just a hit or two with minimal effort once you did a bit of theorycrafting.

Now, Rage will passively grow over time and only diminish when Rurik isn’t fighting. This means a bigger payoff when his Rage really triggers.
A few passives and talents have been reworked to support this change.[/i][/p][/quote][p] 
    Unbroken Rage (Courage passive)
[/p][list][*][p]Old: Increases Rage duration and Rage gains[/p][/*][*][p]New: Increases Rage duration and the Rage gauge decreases slower[/p][/*][/list][p] 
    State of Violence (Courage passive)
[/p][list][*][p]Old: Increases Rage duration and Rage gains.[/p][/*][*][p]New: Increases Rage inertia (the duration before the Rage gauge decreases) and the Rage gauge fills faster.[/p][/*][/list][p] 
    Fierce Loathing (Resilience passive)
[/p][list][*][p]Old: Reduced armor while Rage is at maximum, but increases damage dealt and vampirism for a short time[/p][/*][*][p]New: Reduced armor while Rage is active, but increases damage dealt and vampirism[/p][/*][/list][p] 
    Draconic Ascension (talent)
[/p][list][*][p]Old: Fire a damaging laser when Rage is high (with a cooldown) that immobilises enemies. Reduces maximum Rage[/p][/*][*][p]New: For the entire Rage duration, continuously strike enemies around the barbarian with adaptive damage. The Rage gauge decreases slower[/p][/*][/list][p] 
    Savage Assault (talent)
[/p][list][*][p]Old: Maximum Rage is increased, increasing potential damage and cost reduction. Reduces armor to increase damage dealt[/p][/*][*][p]New: The Rage gauge fills faster. Reduces armor to increase damage dealt[/p][/*][/list][p] 
    Supernatural Cold (talent)
[/p][list][*][p]Old: Direct damage has a chance to slow enemies while Rage is high. Reduces Rage loss and increases damage dealt to impaired enemies[/p][/*][*][p]New: Direct damage has a chance to freeze enemies while the Rage is active. Increases Rage duration and damage dealt to impaired enemies
[/p][/*][/list][p]      Unrestrained Frenzy (talent) [/p][list][*][p]Old: Grants attack speed depending on the Rage gauge, with higher minimum Rage and lower Rage loss.[/p][/*][*][p]New: Grants attack speed depending on the Rage gauge, locks maximum bonuses while the Rage is active. Rage duration is decreased, but the gauge starts higher[/p][/*][/list][p] 
    War Cry (talent)
[/p][list][*][p]Old: Rage increases critical chance and damage. Thorn damage can be critical at max rank[/p][/*][*][p]New: Passively grants critical chances. Increases critical damage for the Rage duration. Thorn damage can be critical at max rank.[/p][/*][/list][p] 

     [i]Ancestral grid[/i]

    🔥All ancestral grids now start with more available hexagons and are fully unlocked by level 45 (previously level 50) [/p][quote][p][i]This should give players a chance to experiment with the grid earlier, or simply let you equip more skills and modifiers in the early levels. This change should also reduce the frustration of always feeling like your grid was just a little too small.[/i][/p][/quote][p] [/p][list][*][p]Earlier great benedictor access (CIty level 9 → City level 6)[/p][/*][*][p]🔥Recall warp is now way shorter (5s → 2s)    [/p][/*][*][p] The death penalty is now reset on map change, not only when returning to Montescail
    [/p][/*][/list][p]
⚖️ [b]Balance[/b]


    🔥Affix and loot rate update
[/p][list][*][p]Less gear drop overall…    [/p][/*][*][p]…but better drop rates for higher rarities
    [/p][/*][/list][p]  

     [i]Knight[/i]

    🔥Fuel (innate ability)


    Fuel regeneration : 5 / second → 10 / second
[/p][quote][p][i]Lothair needed a bit of help with his fuel mechanic, which proved interesting in early-mid game, but quickly became obsolete in late game because of lack of theorycrafting options.

With our new modifier and this small boost, we hope you will reconsider some skills that proved a bit too costly in the previous update, and if not, we’ll look at the numbers again and fine-tune them for next time.[/i][/p][/quote][p]    [/p][p] Offensive Rempart[/p][list][*][p]Now scale with ‘duration’ and lasts 50% longer[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Magnetic Shield[/p][list][*][p]Hit frequency on same target vastly reduced (DPS will stay the same vs groups, but will be weaker on single-target, especially bigger enemies)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Flamethrower[/p][list][*][p]Damage reduced by 25%[/p][/*][/list][p] 

     [i]Oracle[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Electric wave[/p][list][*][p]Vision effects now surges back to the player[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Ethereal Darts[/p][list][*][p]Vision effects now fire additional projectiles for a short time,
instead of only during the initial cast[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Electric Wall[/p][list][*][p]Speed bonus does not stack, only refreshes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Chaotic Armour[/p][list][*][p]Grants unstoppable for 3s → Grants +20% armour for 3s[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Antagonistic Energy (talent)[/p][list][*][p]Spheres rotation speed now scale with the Oracle’s movement speed[/p][/*][*][p]Removed low cooldowns from various skills (mostly Barbarian and Knight skills)[/p][/*][/list][p]
🗺️[b]Environment
[/b][/p][list][*][p] Adjusted lighting for characters and enemies across most levels
[/p][/*][/list][p]🐉[b]Enemies & Boss
[/b][/p][list][*][p]🔥The corrupted bandit in the plains now applies a slow effect instead of a stun    [/p][/*][*][p] Most basic enemies now have more precise attack hitboxes and can no longer hit multiple targets (mostly relevant for summoning builds)
[/p][/*][/list][p]
✨[b]Quality of Life (QoL)
[/b][/p][list][*][p] Removed auto-equip for gear and fragments (only relevant in early game)    [/p][/*][*][p] Memorialist: Added feedback when an incompatible modifier is added to gear (currently only occurs with wyrmling fragments)    [/p][/*][*][p] In the Test of Will, players now remain invulnerable until the next wave starts    [/p][/*][*][p] In all other areas, players remain invulnerable during loading    [/p][/*][*][p] Updated feedback when a map change is required to continue a quest    [/p][/*][*][p] Added the ability to unbind input mappings using the right mouse button
[/p][/*][/list][p]
🖥️[b]Menu & UI[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Added a button to quit the game directly, with confirmation popups and automatic save on exit    [/p][/*][*][p] Added feedback when deleting a group, character, or city    [/p][/*][*][p] Integrated keyword search textures in the ancestral grid    [/p][/*][*][p] Highlighted primary affixes in tooltips and added the ability to display if an affix is both divine and rerolled    [/p][/*][*][p] Added suffixes to city names    [/p][/*][*][p] Updated text when exiting the game from the pause menu to indicate potential quest progress loss[/p][/*][*][p] Updated the game guide to include new skills for each character, the new tracker, and all wyrmling skills[/p][/*][*][p] Better Group display (Added Current Quest Name, Difficulty)[/p][/*][*][p] Update the visuals of city view upgrade points (clearer lock state and upgrade potential)
[/p][/*][/list][p]
🎥[b]Cutscenes & VFX[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Added a visual to Rage (barbarian innate ability)    [/p][/*][*][p] Hidden invincible visual during cinematics    [/p][/*][*][p] Updated the last panorama in the Mengerika springs
[/p][/*][/list][p]
🚀[b]Graphics options[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Unreal Engine updated to 5.5
 [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]\[Fixes][/b][/h3][p]
🐛[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[i]Combat & skills[/i]
[/p][list][*][p] Fixed an issue where city portals were not activated in some cases    [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Fire elite affix not appearing on the floor when jumping with Barbarian.    [/p][/*][*][p] Slowing tornados for Tempest Rift now work properly    [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed mobility scaling on skills (was not always applying)    [/p][/*][*][p] Added missing duration values on some wyrmling tooltips    [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed duration scaling for multiple skills    [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed dodge distance scaling for all classes    [/p][/*][*][p] 🔥Fixed damage calculation with maxed-out Oracle Shield: full HP now correctly considered 'healthy'[/p][/*][/list][p]
[i]Misc.[/i]
[/p][list][*][p] Fixed an issue where city portals were not activated in some cases    [/p][/*][*][p] Damage-over-time visuals are now more consistent, especially with Symbiosis    [/p][/*][*][p] Blood splashes are now correctly oriented    [/p][/*][*][p] 🔥Fixed issue of Test of Will starting at Trial 3 when it wasn't intended    [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issue in the Test of Will where Intense mode was marked as completed after only one trial    [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Green Boss Phase 3 fog effect being culled by distance    [/p][/*][*][p] 🔥Fixed affix choice augment for the Eternal Gift that would add an extra affix to any equipment    [/p][/*][*][p] 🔥Fixed Grand Benedictor modifier incorrectly applying to all skills when a modifier was selected without a skill    [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where the player could leave the map and walk in the air    [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed bleed visual effect causing frame drops on large enemies (e.g., Green Boss).    [/p][/*][*][p] 🔥Fixed loot tooltip preview remaining visible during panoramas or other cinematics    [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issue where fragments could be lost and stuck behind the skill grid
    [/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]With the release of the Tracker update, we're aware of several issues, some more significant than others.  While none are critical enough to delay the update, we’re actively working on a Hotfix we plan to push in the following weeks. This will give us the time we need to thoroughly test the fixes. [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3594840/Dragonkin_The_Banished__Founder_Pack_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]Towards the Multiplayer Update . . .[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’re grateful for all the support and feedback the game has received over the past months, which has made it possible for us to improve the game together with you.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope this gives our devoted players plenty of reasons to revisit [i]Dragonkin: The Banished[/i], and encourage new players to join the hunt, especially since we know many were waiting for the Tracker class to jump into our game.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll be back soon with more updates, specifically on the multiplayer.[/p][p]See you![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/df5edd03500e88a5012160813c2f99ea24a3a01b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Polishing the Tracker Update: Tooltips, UI & More...
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Dragon hunters, and welcome to another Dev Blog![/p][p][/p][p]Over the past few weeks, the team have been working on any reminding bugs you've reported as well as polishing the content of the Tracker Update.[/p][p]Meanwhile, we’ve officially started working on multiplayer integration, which will be the focus of our 3rd major update.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/d96e4501159c4dca1afa9c46920e70cbc3acca2f.png"][/img][/p][p]With that, let’s take a closer look at what changed…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/805e9c8f1631f36863a1095278a6eda5e6168160.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Polishing Tooltips[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]One of the requests we’ve received from the community was for more transparent and detailed tooltips, and if you’ve been following our recent DevBlogs, you know we’ve been working on it.[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]TLDR[/b] We enhanced the visibility and readability of tooltips, removed item score, and added actual numerical values.[/i][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/03120721047e03ca20e63898dfb8272a34af8c25.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Better Chests[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We have been working on making chests scattered around the map more visible.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Now, chests should be much easier to spot![/b][/p][p][/p][p]On top of that, we’re making chests a bit more interesting, as these will now have a [i]slight [/i]chance to drop legendary or mythical equipment, which wasn’t the case before.[/p][p]We hope this will makes picking them up feel a bit more worthwhile.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/f59d7b7ce8077822120820cb97202e30653559f2.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]User Interface tweaks & New art[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Our [b]Graphic Designer[/b], [i]Bastien Limelette[/i], has been busy adding new visuals, polishing the UI (User Interface) to make it more unique to each class.[/p][p][/p][p]Now each character got a different visual when opening the inventory, a small touch, we think adds some flavor.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/4acb7bff37fa5138f973f04eeb1beefbf340f632.png"][/img][/p][p]Along those lines, each class now has unique ring art, including their upgrades.[/p][p][/p][p]That said, regardless of the visual appearance, [b]all rings are transferable and can be worn by any class[/b] (e.g., you can equip a ring with the Oracle visual on a Knight).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/3228ea16b36039678cf520d478e1c959ae7efd0e.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re polishing up the [b]quest log[/b] to make it easier to read and quicker to understand.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/6996208f1b65b4de5e5e4a9084be58cdc12a5d84.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]That’s it for today[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoyed the read![/p][p]We have a lot of improvements coming and we did polish UI elements here and there we didn't show but you'll discover in the Tracker Update.[/p][p]If you like what you see and feel like spreading the word about [i]Dragonkin[/i], don’t hesitate to share your DevBlogs![/p][p][/p][p]Also, feel free to come say hi on Discord![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time…[/p][p]Cheers!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/df5edd03500e88a5012160813c2f99ea24a3a01b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Addressing Community Feedback & Anticipated Changes
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Dragon hunters,[/p][p][/p][p]We want to start with a huge thank you to all new and recurring players who are currently playing to our first major update: [b][i]Nurõrgartt[/i].[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/812976f876a0547d87b73c91927ba118de274c8c.png"][/img][/p][p]Honestly, we’re really pleased to see that the new content sparked interest and it’s always exciting to see new people getting on board daily as well as returning players.[/p][p]We truly appreciate all the feedback you share on Discord. While we may not answer every message, please know that we read everything you post and consider every possibility on the major points you raised.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been teasing the content of the [b]Tracker update [/b]already and this time we’d like to talk about:[/p][p][/p][h3]What are the major points we want to work on and address?[/h3][p][/p][p]But before we break into it, let’s take a look at what you can expect.
[/p][h2][b]Tracker Update Overview[/b][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Class:  Qara Tani, the Tracker[/b][/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]Named Qara Tani, she is a tracker from the Qhongirat, using the advanced archery techniques of her clan along with a deadly poison derived from the blood of a Green Dragon.[/i][/p][p][i]As a Dragon hunter, she is able to wield all the martial techniques of her clan, ranging from formidable close-combat skills to powerful ranged attacks.[/i][/p][p][i]Her specialty: striking without being struck.[/i]
[/p][p][i]Coming with a total of 17 skills, she has both melee and ranged abilities.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Biome: [i]Erde-nòr[/i][/b][/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]2 new regions: The Volcanic Plains of Koleos & The Resurgence Stronghold.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Skills for each classes[/b][/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]2 new skills for each class, including the Knight, the Barbarian, and the Oracle.[/i][/p][p][i]17 skills for the Tracker.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Modifiers[/b][/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]9 new modifiers, for each class, including the Knight, the Barbarian, Oracle and the Tracker.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Endgame content & Draconic Tarot[/b][/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]New endgame hunts, dungeons, enemies  and bosses.[/i][/p][p][i]With the Draconic Tarot, you will be able to customize your Chaos Hunts modifiers.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Enemies : Champions[/b][/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]The Champions are new enemies you’ll be able to find in quests.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New City feature: The Draconic Atlas[/b][/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]The Draconic Atlas is designed to help you learn more about the enemies you encountered during your hunts, while also providing passive bonuses that apply to all characters tied to the same City.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Quality of Life (QoL) features: Loot Filter, Death Recap, and more…[/b][/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]With the loot filter, you’ll be able to create templates, set rules, and sort them by priority. But also, hide, display, or highlight specific types of items.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]The Death Recap will help you to interpret what caused you to die.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][p][b]Our Roadmap:[/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/eb794823ee5cdefaf3d3638fc37cb15649a5202e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/3fa2650b54f5d93dc715dbdd03ab4c4a065b877b.png"][/img][/p][p]Now let’s take a look at not only new content we never mentioned before and the major points we’d like to address and will be our focus for the following months.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]More interesting enemies to fight: the Champions[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The Champions are a new kind of elite enemies you’ll hunt during endgame hunts. Some Champions also are entirely new foes you haven't encountered before.[/p][p][/p][p]Our intention is to offer more interesting and challenging encounters, making fights more strategic at key moments of hunts and the story.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll be sharing more details about them in the following weeks, as we’re hoping to release a few of those new enemies in our next Update, planned for [b]Summer 2025[/b]. It’s something we think will be deeply appreciated.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Loot Filter is on Its way[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]As requested by the community since the start of EA, we’ve been working on it a few weeks ago.[/p][p][/p][p]We know that wading through piles of loot just to find that [i]one[/i] useful item isn’t a fun experience. That’s why we’ve begun working on a loot filter that will help you spot the most interesting items quickly and target farm more efficiently.[/p][p][/p][p]If you actually want more info on it such as how it works, we dedicated a DevBlog on the Loot Filter.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Getting One Shot isn’t fun + Death Recap[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Let’s be honest, getting one shot out of nowhere definitely isn’t fun and neither an interesting player experience. [b]Specifically the ones that kill you out of nowhere.[/b]
[/p][p]That’s not the kind of difficulty we want. We’re reviewing the one-shot mechanics, to make sure damage spikes feel fair and avoidable. Because you should always feel like you [i]could[/i] have dodged or blocked, not like the game just rolled a dice behind your back.[/p][p][/p][p]Enemies will no longer deal massive chunks of damage to the character (with some exceptions), and likewise, it’ll take a bit more effort for the player to take them down.[/p][p][/p][p]Overall, fights will last longer. We hope this will make combat more strategic and engaging. On a side note, we are working on a Death Recap to help the players to understand what happened and improve on the next encounter.[/p][h3]
[b]More transparency in Tooltips[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]One thing you’ve been pointing out, and you’re absolutely right, is that many of our tooltips are just too vague. Sentences like [i]“Grants a temporary evasion bonus upon use”[/i] just don’t give you enough info when you’re trying to theorycraft or build around specific effects.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We’re changing that.[/b][/p][p]
We’ve started revising tooltips to be clearer. For example, that same line would become: [i]“+X% Evasion for a brief time upon use.”[/i]. That said, terms like [i]temporary[/i], [i]brief[/i], or [i]short[/i] are still going to be displayed. Ideally, we’d love to show exact durations.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Why don’t we just do that now?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]In a lot of cases, durations aren’t fixed.[/p][p]They can scale with many effects and as of now, showing the duration could lead to inaccurate or misleading information, which we think could be worse than being vague. That’s why we’re approaching this carefully.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We also want to remove the Item Score (item level) from tooltips.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]At first glance, Item Score seems helpful. It gives a quick idea of an item’s “power,” right? But in practice, it's more complicated than that. The score is meant to guide players by showing that an item generally has higher stats. However, they can also nudge players into equipping gear that may actually be worse for their specific build.[/p][p]Meanwhile, experienced players often see flat scoring systems as misleading and tend to ignore them altogether. Ultimately, we’d rather players evaluate gear based on what it actually [i]does[/i], the stats, the affixes, the synergy with their build, rather than judge on a single abstract number.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Character Progression & More obtainable skills in the story[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Due to the randomness, it can be frustrating for new players to progress through the story without discovering new skills. This often makes the experience feel dry, especially during the early levels when players are still exploring the game's systems and want to experiment.[/p][p][/p][p]To address this, players will be guaranteed to find skill Fragments at key moments in the story, typically after major quests, similar to how the [i]Gift of the Eternal[/i] is awarded.[/p][p][/p][p]We've previously discussed our goal of adding more "wow" moments to the player's progression, and we hope this change contributes to that experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Prologue & Onboarding[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Since Early Access launched, we’ve been going through a ton of feedback, and one thing that came up a lot is the prologue and the initial walk through Montescail.
[/p][p]Some of you liked being able to try out different classes early on (which is awesome), but overall, we’ve heard that the prologue felt just too long for many of our players. The [i]constant [/i]voice-over and up to 20 minutes of dialogue were often mentioned as overwhelming.[/p][p][/p][p]During that time, the player is basically unkillable, one-shotting everything, and loot is disabled for story purpose. While it’s not a big issue, when it stretches out for that long, it just isn't [i]fun[/i].[/p][p][/p][p][b]That’s why we’re already working on reducing the length of the prologue.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Another major point of feedback concerns the very first walk through the City of Montescail.[/p][p][/p][p]When players arrive in the City for the first time, they’re required to walk through the City while listening to dialogue before reaching the next quest point. Although our goal was to introduce the City in an immersive way, we now understand that this part feels tedious and not engaging.[/p][p][/p][p][b]As a result, we’ve decided to completely remove that initial walk.[/b][/p][h3][b]
New Modifiers[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Alongside the new skills we’ve been working on, we’d like to introduce a total of 9 modifiers.[/p][p][/p][p]Some of these new modifiers are a bit special as each one is [i]unique to a specific class[/i].[/p][p]They're designed to complement each class’s core identity and should open to more interesting build paths, making theorycrafting more flexible.[/p][p][/p][p]If you're curious, we shared a preview of these new modifiers on our Discord.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]To learn more about the Tracker update:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1863430/view/544486109101425001"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1863430/view/498323476114834553"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1863430/view/498325386812198381"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1863430/view/498325386812195979"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1863430/view/498324752822173944"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]Looking ahead[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We really hope you’ll like these changes and are eager to learn more about all these future features and changes.[/p][p]We are committed to keeping you informed as we implement these updates and are actively working to ensure that these changes are positive for both new and experienced players.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Sharing Your Experience[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We want to know how you get on with the [i]Nurõrgartt [/i]update, join us on Discord.[/p][p]And with that, we’ll catch you next time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/df5edd03500e88a5012160813c2f99ea24a3a01b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.notes:
Hello Dragon hunters,

We are delighted to announce that Dragonkin's [b]First Major Update[/b], the [i][b]Nurõrgartt[/b][/i] patch has arrived!

[b]Please take a look at our Trailer:[/b]

[previewyoutube=sE8mhoDe8d0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Oh! And Founder Pack 2 is here! Download it right here:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3594840/Dragonkin_The_Banished__Founder_Pack_2/

This patch introduces our 1st Major Update features and QoL updates requested by the community, along with several bug fixes.

As always, thank you to everyone who reported bugs and provided feedback to us!

Your support is crucial in shaping the future of Dragonkin and thanks to our fans, we’ve been able to go beyond the scope of what was in our initial roadmap.

A quick note regarding [b]Steam Deck[/b] support, [i]Dragonkin: The Banished[/i] is now officially playable! We’ll continue working toward full compatibility.

Patch notes will feature a [b][🔥][/b] emoji whenever the change is based on community feedback!

[h3][b][Highlights][/b][/h3]

[list]
    [*][b]6 new character skills[/b]
 [quote][i]2 for each class, including: the Knight, the Barbarian, and the Oracle.[/i][/quote][/list][list]
    [*][b]3 new Wyrmling skills[/b]
[quote][i]1 for the Ice Wyrmling and 2 for the Toxic Wyrmling.[/i][/quote] [/list][list]
    [*][b]5 new Services in the City of Montescail[/b]
[quote][i]The Enchanter, The Memorialist, The Grand Benedictor, The Artificer, The Arsenal will be added to your city.

These are designed to give you more control around your itemization and builds.[/i][/quote] [/list][list]
    [*][b]New Biome: [i]Nurõrgartt[/i][/b]
[quote][i]4 new levels in The Tundra and the Glacier environments.

New dungeon purification: The Ice Cavern.

New enemies, and bosses to discover.[/i][/quote] [/list][list]
    [*][b]New endgame activity: Test of Will[/b]
[quote][i]In this mode, you'll face wave after wave of enemies while dealing with a mix of temporary buffs and debuffs, along with permanent bonuses that last throughout the run.[/i][/quote] [/list][list]
    [*][b]New kind of reward: Gift of the Eternal[/b]
[quote][i]In our ongoing efforts to enhance player agency and reward progression, we'd like to introduce a new kind of reward: Gift of the Eternal.

Our goal with that new reward is to provide meaningful choices that respect your time and investment in the game. By allowing you to select rewards that align with your goals, we aim to enhance your gameplay experience and progression satisfaction.​[/i][/quote] [/list][list]
    [*][b]🔥New Storage Chest for Fragments[/b]
[quote][i]Many players have expressed frustration over the limited storage space for Fragments and we've heard you!

That’s why we introduce the Fragment chest! You’ll now find several Fragment chests scattered throughout the city, right alongside the familiar Equipment chest.[/i][/quote] [/list][list]
    [*][b]15 new endgame hunts[/b]
[quote][i]New rewards to unlock on the Hunting Board for chaos hunts and for the Gift of the Eternal. Most Hunts happen in the new biome “Nurõrgartt”.[/i][/quote] [/list][list]
    [*][b]🔥Progression & loot adjustments[/b]
[quote][i]Your feedback highlighted how the overall level progression, especially between levels 30 to 45 could feel underwhelming and unrewarding.

With this patch, we’ve taken the first steps to make leveling more satisfying by allowing players to obtain more interesting and high-rarity drops much earlier.

Our intention is to add more 'wow' moments for the player and make progression before max level feel exciting.

As such, [b]Divine & Draconic[/b] are now available starting at [b]level 1[/b] and [b]Mythical[/b] items drop from [b]level 30 instead of 45[/b]. The Gift of the Eternal, which can drop in the storyline and offers rarer items, should help reinforce that rewarding sense of progression.[/i][/quote] [/list][list]
    [*][b]🔥Gameplay adjustment[/b]
[quote][i]This patch brings a wide wave of gameplay refinements aimed at making the core experience feel better. As such, we’ve touched many parts of the gameplay.

[b]Expect:[/b] increased enemy density, combat feel and responsiveness, loot visibility, difficulty adjustments, and of course overall skill balance.[/i][/quote] [/list][list]
    [*][b]Quality of Life (QoL) & New options[/b]
[quote][i]We are adding in-game guides, features like level-up notifications, and improving tooltip readability.

[b]We also really want our players to customize their experience.[/b]

That’s why we’re adding plenty of settings for you to mess around with, such as high-contrast cursor, minimap transparency, camera distance, NPC and Enemy Highlight options, Colorblind mode and more.[/i][/quote] [/list][list]
    [*][b]Founder Pack 2 available[/b]
[quote][i][b]Dragonkin: The Banished. Founder Pack 2 contains:[/b]

6 exclusive pieces of equipment including a chest and a helmet for your heroes (2 per character)

6 exclusive visual effects allowing you to add a trail to your Wyrmling.

The exclusive pack “Day of the Dead Dragon” includes cosmetic elements for your city: statues, roofs, flags and pennants.[/i][/quote] [/list]

[h3][b][New Features][/b][/h3]

🎮[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
    [*]2 New skills for each class, including: the Knight, the Barbarian, and the Oracle

     [i]Knight[/i]

[list]
    [*]Compressed Air
[quote][i]Lothair pulls enemies inward and deals fire damage to them. While this ability has no cooldown and can be cast repeatedly, each use consumes Fuel.[/i][/quote] [/list][list]
    [*]Offensive Rempart
[quote][i]Lothair braces his shield in a chosen direction, channeling for a few seconds. During this time, he gains a huge chunk of armor and delivers continuous strikes in front of him while blocking incoming projectiles from the front.[/i][/quote] [/list]
     [i]Oracle[/i]

[list]
    [*]Psychokinesis
[quote][i]Electrane unleashes a shockwave that pulls enemies after a few seconds, briefly stunning them and dealing physical damage afterwards.

[b]Vision:[/b] Instantly pulls enemies and deals damage, allowing you to use it as a reaction spell.[/i][/quote] [/list][list]
    [*]Electric Wall
[quote][i]Electrane creates a passable electric wall. Enemies that pass through it are slowed and take damage over time while allies who pass through the wall gain increased movement speed.

[b]Vision:[/b] The wall increases in size, letting you cover larger areas and better control chokepoints.[/i][/quote] [/list]

[list]

    [*]3 New Wyrmling skills, including: 1 for the ice wyrmling and 2 for the Toxic Wyrmling

By sacrificing legendary and mythic items, as well as fragments of any rarity, you can permanently record bonuses within your Codex.[/i][/quote] [/list][list]

Of course, everything can be adjusted in settings.[/i][/quote] [/list][list]

[quote][i]Calamity III is now the minimum difficulty required to farm Divine ingredients.

These are used to craft Divine items such as rings, potions and Wyrmling armors, but also modify your freshly acquired Divine gear via the Enchanter or Memorialist.[/i][/quote] [/list][list]
  [*]🔥Gold, dust and crafting ingredients are now shared between all characters

Since we want to encourage players to create alts, we decided to allow these resources to be shared across all characters on your account, as long as they are created in the same city.

[quote][i]This change aims to make it easier for players to quickly identify valuable or interesting drops. Now, you'll be able to instantly recognize if an item is Divine, Draconic, if not both, or another key rarity without having to pick it up first.

Previously, players had to pick up equipment to check its stats or fragment to see what it contains, even if they already knew it was Divine, Draconic or a specific size of fragment.


This wasn’t ideal, especially when the inventory would be filled up pretty fast, forcing players to either drop items on the ground or make trips back to town to sell them.

We want to respect your time and investment, so you can now spot interesting items at a glance and preview their details when you hover them, before committing to pick them up.[/i][/quote] [/list] [list]

     [*] Fixed the failed protection objective not resetting correctly in the endgame quest “The Pilgrimage”
     [*] Fixed an issue where cultists in the swamp of Jak’Sara would ignore the player in the endgame quest, “No more”
     [*] Fixed an issue where certain enemies were not attacking during protects or wave events
[/list]
[i]Menu & UI[/i]
[list]
     [*] Fixed an issue where items wouldn’t get equipped when dragged onto the character preview  
     [*] Fixed an issue where the BattleLog button would get focused in certain cases after a cinematic
     [*] Fixed activation issues when using a gamepad, specifically when opening the world map while the quest log was focused
     [*] Fixed hold buttons showing progress animation even when a city upgrade is locked
     [*] Fixed an issue that would occur when trying to craft a potion while having no inventory space available
     [*] Fixed scroll bar issues with mouse interaction on the difficulty selection popup
     [*] Fixed flickering when placing the cursor between two fragments
     [*] Fixed a bug where floating fragment count and keyword search wouldn’t update correctly
     [*] Fixed an issue where the relic count in the world map would sometimes fail to update
     [*] Fixed an issue with the Ornament slot 4 number not displayed correctly
     [*] Fixed the position of an inaccessible chest in the plains, making it properly accessible  
     [*] Fixed an issue where difficulty settings wouldn’t persist across menu resets
[/list]
[i]Combat & skills[/i]
[list]
     [*] Merged the behavior of damage over time effects for better consistency and scaling across abilities  
     [*] Fixed an issue causing endless elite spawns during wave-based events  
     [*] Fixed a bug where passive skills would be lost on death if the player met their attribute requirements through equipment  
     [*] Fixed the Barbarian’s Meteoric Projection not triggering some Wyrmling skills  
     [*] Fixed the Barbarian’s War Cry talent, it was not supposed to be already available but is now working properly  
     [*] Fixed the Toxic Wyrmling’s Dark Affliction skill not triggering  
     [*] Fixed the Big Hitter passive skill (bonus damage with reduced attack speed)  
     [*] Fixed the Vengeance potion effect not being applied correctly  
     [*] Fixed a bug that occurred when stacking the Vision of the Oracle class  
     [*] Fixed the elite damage multiplier and resistance not being correctly used in the damage calculations  
     [*] Improved pathfinding for ranged enemies to reduce instances of them getting stuck behind obstacles and walls  
     [*] Fixed infinite range attacks from Dragon Flowers and Mutant Bandits  
     [*] Fixed the fire Elite affix incorrectly applying effects at unlimited range, this affix also now disappears shortly after the Elite’s death  
     [*] Fixed an issue where some elite enemies were not receiving the proper bonus statistics from their affixes  
     [*] Fixed the visual effects of dodge flask augments not adapting to the Wyrmling’s elemental type  
     [*] Fixed lingering remnant visual effects on dead enemies  
     [*] Fixed a bug causing bad interactions between the Barbarian’s jump and boss phase transitions  
     [*] Fixed a positioning issue where the wyrmling would appear in the wrong location after using a teleport skill in combination with a Wyrmling skill  
     [*] Fixed a bug where the healing orb talent wasn’t properly healing  
     [*] Fixed an issue where the Knight’s Rallying Banner wasn’t correctly applying elemental resistances  
     [*] Fixed an issue where the Control talent was not applying the correct number of marks when triggered by very short status effects or continuous stat effects  
[/list]
[i]Miscellaneous[/i]
[list]
     [*] Players can no longer die during cinematics  
     [*] Fixed an issue where players had to leave and re-enter the city for newly unlocked upgrades to take effect  
     [*] Hunt augments are now disabled during a story group, as they do not have access to the augments menu in that context  
     [*] Fixed animation issues with Wyrmlings wearing an armor during cinematics  
     [*] Fixed an issue with MyNacon's email validation where valid domains like .co.uk were incorrectly marked as invalid  
     [*] Fixed an issue where torch and brasero light flickering was unnecessarily heavy on CPU usage  
     [*] Fixed a bug where playable characters could still be rotated while dead  
     [*] Fixed an issue where Cyrrha’s panorama would not correctly unlock the associated minimap area  
     [*] Fixed Chaos Hunt generation not selecting the correct biome when using a specific boss rule  
     [*] Fixed visible gameplay visual effect appearing during cutscenes  
[/list]

[h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2]

With the release of the Nurõrgartt update, we're aware of several issues, some more significant than others.

While none are critical enough to delay the update, we’re actively working on a Hotfix scheduled for release next week. This will give us the time we need to thoroughly test the fixes.

[b]As for now:[/b]

[list]
     [*] "Fire by Fire" (endgame quest) cannot be completed.

     [*] "The Gift of the Eternal" does not give Divine Resources.

     [*] The Safe Distance modifier is currently non-functional.

     [*] The elite affix "Guardian" can stack indefinitely, potentially preventing enemies from being killed.

     [*] A crash may occur when rerolling a Hexagon from a Fragment using the Enchanter.

     [*] Chaos Hunt settings reset after returning to town post-hunt.

     [*] The Ice Wyrmling Armor "Okaenos Cobalt Armour" has a wrong talent.

     [*] The "Elementary pseudopod" enemy is incorrectly providing constant shield regeneration
[/list]

We’d like to inform you of a bug we've identified, that we won't be able to fix in the upcoming hotfix.

In the patch notes, we mention a fix where ranged enemies would sometimes get stuck if there was an obstacle (like a rock) between them and the player, only when the player is standing close to that obstacle. This preventing enemies from chasing the player properly.

However, this fix has inadvertently caused the same issue to affect melee enemies, which was not the case before.

[b]Temporary Workaround:[/b]

If you encounter this bug, simply moving around should help "unstick" the enemies and get them back on track.

We appreciate your patience and support while we work to resolve these.

[h2][b]Your feedback helps![/b][/h2]

Thank you for bringing issues to our attention so we were able to fix them quickly!

As usual, if you come across any further issues or bugs, please report them on Discord so we can investigate and get fixes out! Naughty little bugs! Blame this guy 🐛

Also, we’ll say it again, but we’re building this game alongside the community. So if you have suggestions, we want to hear them. Whether our Discord or the Steam Discussions, we’ll be there!

And with that, see you next time!

notes.title: Nurõrgartt Update is Coming on May 20th & Patch Teaser!
notes.notes:
Hello Dragon Hunter,

[h3][b]The day is set![/b][/h3]

[i]Dragonkin: The Banished[/i]'s first major update, [i][b]Nurõrgartt[/b][/i] will be released on [b]May 20th![/b]

We made a new teaser to celebrate the occasion, we hope you're as excited as we are!
Please check it out:

[previewyoutube=F531xI37hYM;full][/previewyoutube]

The scope of this update went way beyond what we initially envisioned. This was only made possible through the warm and constructive feedback we have been given with these past months. Thank you so much everyone for your support!

Our upcoming patch notes as well as this DevBlog will feature a [b][🔥] emote[/b] whenever the change is based on community feedback!

[h2][b][i]Nurõrgartt[/i] Update Overview[/b][/h2]

Now let's take a took at the key changes you can expect in our first major update:

[list]
    [*][h3][b]6 new character skills[/b][/h3]
[/list][quote][i]2 for each class, including the Knight, the Barbarian, and the Oracle.[/i][/quote] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/fe7cd15e8d8a5f6af81ae271bb49a1c2dd19c318.png[/img]
To learn more about these new skills, please check our Devblog:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1863430/view/498320947205374001
[list]
    [*][h3][b]3 New Wyrmling skills[/b][/h3]
[/list][quote][i]1 for the ice Wyrmling and 2 for the toxic Wyrmling.[/i][/quote] [list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/3fe7424ffedcc4861e9ceaa948b92852b8a47540.png[/img]
    [*][h3][b]5 New Services in the City of Montescail[/b][/h3]
[/list][quote][i]The Enchanter, The Memorialist, The Grand Benedictor, The Artificer, The Arsenal will be added to your city.

These are designed to give you more control around your itemization and builds.[/i][/quote] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/b171abe9ce72d755fe7a3c65b90cc9c381c020e1.png[/img]
To learn more about these new Services, please check our Devblog:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1863430/view/498319044783374510
[list]
    [*][h3][b]New Biome: [i]Nurõrgartt[/i][/b][/h3]
[/list][quote][i]2 new environments: The Tundra and the Glacier.

New dungeon: The Ice Cavern.

New enemies, and bosses to discover.[/i][/quote] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/c663d7722a1580a760d378b001f64743d42263c4.png[/img]
For a deeper dive into the new biome, please check our Devblog:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1863430/view/498317142563751877
[list]
    [*][h3][b]New endgame activity: Test of Will[/b][/h3]
[/list][quote][i]In this mode, you'll face wave after wave of enemies while dealing with a mix of temporary buffs and debuffs, along with permanent bonuses that last throughout the run.

Each wave gets harder with stronger enemies, but the further you go, the better the rewards.[/i][/quote] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/6770066a5eb631fb19d59686129d5b80166d061b.png[/img]
To learn more about this new endgame activity, please check our Devblog: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1863430/view/498319683381887030
[list]
    [*][h3][b]New kind of reward: Gift of the Eternal[/b][/h3]
[/list][quote][i]In our ongoing efforts to enhance player agency and reward progression, we'd like to introduce a new kind of reward: Gift of the Eternal.

Our goal with that new reward is to provide meaningful choices that respect your time and investment in the game. By allowing you to select rewards that align with your goals, we aim to enhance your gameplay experience and progression satisfaction.​[/i][/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/95c97c6feae0e2f8c152e65a7ad4aefe31639e65.png[/img]
To learn more about it, please check our Devblog:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1863430/view/498319683381887486
[list]
    [*][h3][b]🔥New Storage Chest for Fragments[/b][/h3]
[/list][quote][i]Many players have expressed frustration over the limited storage space for Fragments and we've heard you!

[b]That’s why we introduce the Fragment chest![/b]

You’ll now find several Fragment chests scattered throughout the city, right alongside the familiar Equipment chest.​[/i][/quote] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/26c3cef132ca4c5622a4dc5307be3ccfb3e533cf.png[/img]
[list]
    [*][h3][b]15 New endgame hunts[/b][/h3]
[/list][quote][i]New rewards to unlock on the Hunting Board for chaos hunts and for the Gift of the Eternal. Most Hunts happen in the new biome “Nurõrgartt”.​[/i][/quote] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/e3ff03840a32e9e5be288994e38432188d4aa2d3.png[/img]
[list]
    [*][h3][b]🔥Progression & loot adjustments[/b][/h3]
[/list][quote][i]Your feedback highlighted how the overall level progression, especially between levels 30 to 45 could feel underwhelming and unrewarding.

With this patch, we’ve taken the first steps to make leveling more satisfying by allowing players to obtain more interesting and high-rarity drops much earlier. Our intention is to add more '[i]wow[/i]' moments for the player and make progression before max level feel exciting.

As such, [b]Divine & Draconic[/b] items will be available starting [b]at level 1[/b] and [b]Mythical[/b] items [b]at level 30[/b] instead of 45. Also, [b]all rarities[/b] (Uncommon, Rare, Legendary, Mythical) are now obtainable [b]10 levels earlier[/b]. This change does not affect Fragment drops.

The Gift of the Eternal, which can drop in the story and offers rarer items, should help reinforce the sense of progression.[/i][/quote] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/3aefe978bc857ba8196aa8868317af6346078a3a.png[/img]
[list]
    [*][h3][b]🔥Gameplay adjustment[/b][/h3]
[/list][quote][i]This patch brings a wide wave of gameplay refinements aimed at improving the core experience. As such, we’ve reworked many parts of the gameplay.

[b]Expect:[/b] increased enemy density and group variety, combat feel (impact) and responsiveness, loot visibility, difficulty adjustments, and of course overall skill balance.[/i][/quote] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/a7a0e25159178e1ddf91fd8d64f29146e47fc563.png[/img]
[list]
    [*][h3][b]Quality of Life (QoL) & New accessibility options[/b][/h3]
[/list][quote][i]We are adding in-game guides, features like level-up notifications, and improving tooltip readability.

We also really want our players to be able to customize their experience. That’s why we’re adding plenty of settings for you to mess around with, such as high-contrast cursor, minimap transparency, camera distance, NPC and Enemy Highlight options, Colorblind mode and more.[/i][/quote] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/b33298b7d8fe8d53828ec5417d60c60d8cfe20fd.png[/img]
[list]
    [*][h3][b]Founder Pack 2 available[/b][/h3]
[/list][quote][i][b]Dragonkin: The Banished. Founder Pack 2 contains:[/b]

6 exclusive pieces of equipment including a chest and a helmet for your heroes (2 per character)

6 exclusive visual effects allowing you to add a trail to your Wyrmling.

The exclusive pack “Day of the Dead Dragon” includes cosmetic elements for your city: statues, roofs, flags and pennants.
[/i][/quote] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/aa6cdaf96c8906c11afa77d5122330d5c0552009.png[/img]
A few weeks ago, on Discord, we shared a preview of one of the customisations from [b]Founder Pack 2[/b].

Here's a look at the [b]Dark Prophetic Armour[/b] for the Oracle, designed by [i]Agathe Dhondt[/i]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/ca5ae8032ddd6cfaed544424ca2ca195fff38907.png[/img]

[h2][b]About the story[/b][/h2]

We realised that it's possible we hadn't been clear enough about when the rest of the story will be released.

[h3][u][b]We plan to add the additional story acts when we come out of Early Access and fully release Dragonkin: The Banished.[/b][/u][/h3]

We understand that some players are waiting for this before jumping into the game, and we truly appreciate your patience.

We're eager to hear your thoughts on the prologue and the story so far, feel free to share your opinions with us on Discord! Your feedback means a lot to us, and your feedback has had a huge influencer on the upcoming Nurõrgartt update!

[b]Here a reminder of our roadmap:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/5a67537dd7f9fed26f2e513b6c0b0d25ce8b4f85.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Don't forget your Founder Pack 1[/b][/h2]

In the meantime, don’t forget to download [b]Founder Pack 1[/b] if you haven’t already. This pack will expire on [b]May 20th, 2025[/b], and will be replaced by [b]Founder Pack 2[/b]. As a reminder, these are cosmetic gifts that we have prepared for players to mark milestones in our Early Access development journey. Thank you again for joining us.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3462450/Dragonkin_The_Banished__Founder_Pack_1/

[h2][b]What's next?[/b][/h2]

As you can expect, our production velocity is at full throttle and the team is working on refining the [i]Nurõrgartt[/i] update. It’s a long ride, but your overwhelming support goes a long way in keeping the team's motivation high!

We're looking forward to hearing your thoughts on the new systems and changes we've made. We'll be keep an eye on how this update lands while the team starts preparing for our next major update, featuring the introduction of the Tracker. But that's still a little far off, for now...

[h2][b]We'll see you on May 20th![/b][/h2]

As usual, we encourage you to join us on Discord and of course, we’ll be back next week with a big patch note for when the update goes live! 

[url=https://discord.gg/WrCT2E5kG9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904587/df5edd03500e88a5012160813c2f99ea24a3a01b.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Emergency Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello Dragon hunters,

We’ve been reading your reports on issues over the week.
Thank you to everyone who has taken the time to report these issues to us.

We’ve got a hotfix for you today, addressing several bugs and blockers.

We continue to look into your reports and are working on further fixes and as always, reach us on Steam forums or Discord if you run into trouble.

[h3][b]STORY [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Son'kan escort in story chapter 1 “The Lost Scale” Quest.
[*] Fixed Gerome not validating the quest objective properly after joining the player in the jungle in story chapter 1 “Knowledge is a weapon” Quest.
[*] Added a quest icon on the "Join Son'kan" objective in the story chapter 1 “Back to the light” Quest.
[*] Updated objective trigger size to prevent from being missed after joining Son'kan in the Trackers Camp to talk to Yula and Cornelys in the story chapter 1 “The enemy unmasked” Quest.
[/list]

[h3][b]ENDGAME[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Hunting Board Quest 3-1 reward not working.
[*] Fixed Hunting Board Quest 3-3 not validating correctly.
[*] Fixed Hunting Board Quest 5-4 not being completable.
[*] Fixed Hunting Board Quest 4-7 not being accessible due to both previous ones.
[*] Fixed Hunting Board Quest 8-1 not being completable.
[*] Fixed the compass indicator not working properly after dying in some Endgame Hunts.
[/list]

[h3][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where NPC could be stuck running on the spot, preventing them from moving further.
[*] Fixed an issue with NPC allies that could be lost by players because they were stuck out of screen instead of teleporting near the player if too far away.
[/list]
